title: Efficient Lossless Compression of Scientific Floating-Point Data on CPUs and GPUs
problem: Scientific datasets are growing faster than storage and interconnect bandwidth, making data compression essential, but existing lossless compressors for floating-point data are either fast or achieve good compression ratios—rarely both simultaneously on both CPUs and GPUs.
motivation: As GPU-accelerated scientific computing produces ever-larger floating-point datasets, a compressor that is cross-platform (CPU/GPU compatible), high-throughput, and high-ratio eliminates a key I/O bottleneck without becoming a new processing bottleneck.
method: The paper presents four new lossless compression algorithms specifically designed for single- and double-precision IEEE 754 floating-point data. The algorithms are fully compatible between CPUs and GPUs, enabling the same bitstream to be produced/consumed on either platform. Implementations exploit bit-level patterns in floating-point exponent and mantissa fields to achieve high compression ratios, and are tuned for SIMD/SIMT parallelism to maximize throughput on both CPU vector units and GPU streaming multiprocessors. Evaluated against 18 compressors from the literature on SDRBench scientific datasets.
key_novelty: Four floating-point-specific lossless compression algorithms that are simultaneously CPU/GPU bitstream-compatible and achieve best-in-class throughput (>500 GB/s on RTX 4090) without sacrificing compression ratio.
contributions: Four new lossless compression algorithms for single- and double-precision scientific floating-point data
Full CPU-GPU bitstream compatibility enabling cross-platform interoperability
Compression and decompression throughput exceeding 500 GB/s on RTX 4090 GPU
Comprehensive evaluation against 18 compressors on SDRBench showing superior throughput and ratio trade-offs

metrics.other: compress+decompress >500 GB/s on RTX 4090; outperforms most of 18 compared compressors in ratio and throughput

baselines: 18 compressors from the literature on SDRBench
limitations: Lossless only; lossy scientific data compression with error bounds is out of scope.
primary_theme: high-throughput lossless floating-point compression for CPUs and GPUs
